About Us The Ministry of Labour & Employment is one of the oldest and important Ministries of the Government of India. The main responsibility of the Ministry is to protect and safeguard the interests of workers in general and those who constitute the poor, deprived and disadvantage sections of the society, in particular, with due regard to creating a healthy work environment for higher production and productivity and to develop and coordinate vocational skill training and employment services. Government’s attention is also focused on promotion of welfare and providing social security to the labour force both in organized and unorganized sectors, in tandem with the process of liberalization. These objectives are sought to be achieved through enactment and implementation of various labour laws, which regulate the terms and conditions of service and employment of workers. The State Governments are also competent to enact legislations, as labour is a subject in the concurrent list under the Constitution of India. Download on the App Store Frequently asked questions Everything you need to know about using NCS. What is NCS? The National Career Service (NCS) is a one-stop solution offering a wide range of employment and career-related services to the citizens of India, including job search, job matching, career content, counselling, and job fair information. It is an initiative of the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India. Who can register on the portal? Job Seekers, Employers, Skill Providers, Career Counsellors, Local Service Providers, Career Centers, Placement Organisations, Households, and Government Departments. Is NCS free to use? Yes. NCS does not charge any fee at any stage of registration, job application, or interview processing. Jobseekers should not pay fees to employers. Is a mobile app available? Yes. The NCS mobile app is available for finding and applying for jobs. It can be downloaded from the app store links on the portal home page. How can I avoid fake NCS communication? Some websites and individuals falsely claim an association with NCS or use its logo. Please verify information only on the official website, www.ncs.gov.in . You may contact NCS at support.ncs@gov.in or on the toll-free helpline 1514. Cyber fraud can be reported on 1930. Beware of Misleading Communication It has been reported to us that some websites/employers/persons claim to have association with National Career Service (NCS)/Ministry of Labour & Employment (MoLE) are using the logo of NCS. They are fraudulent and tarnishing the image and reputation of NCS. NCS services are free of cost. NCS does not charge any fee at any stage of registration, job application, interview processing and other employment related services. Jobseekers should not pay fees to employers. NCS does not endorse or take responsibility for such practices. Verify information from the official NCS website: www.ncs.gov.in Reach out to us at: support[dot]ncs[at]gov[dot]in 1514 (NCS) 1930 (Cyber Crime) Official Email Addresses: support[dot]ncs[at]gov[dot]in noreply-ncs[at]gov[dot]in no-reply[at]sampark[dot]gov[dot]in Namaste! 👋 Ask me about employment and skill development schemes. POWERGRID strives to have a workforce which reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to

Posting locations of selected candidates in POWERGRID are likely to be in any of the POWERGRID 
offices, substations,  transmission line offices, construction sites  and subsidiaries  spread across the 
country & abroad. 
 
For Eligibility Criteria, Relaxation and Concession, Selection Process, Health, Compensation Package, 
Service Agreement Bond, General Information and instructions , etc.  regarding this recruitment, please 
refer to our detailed  Advt. No. CC /04/2025 dtd. 27.09.202 5 (ET2026throughGATe2026.pdf ). 
 
Empanelment of Candidates:  
 
The empanelment of candidates  shall be as under: - 
 
Candidates shortlisted for G roup Discussion  and interview may have to undergo Psychometric  
Assessment, results of which shall be used as an input during the interview. Candidates who qualify in 
Personal Interview will only be adjudged suitable for empanelment.  
 
Candidates  should have qualified in GATE 202 6 and in Personal Interview separately in order to be 
considered eligible for empanelment.  
 
Please note that only GATE 202 6 score (Normalized Marks out of 100) is valid for this 
recruitment process. GATE score of 202 5 or prior is not valid.  
 
Selected candidates shall be notified through their candidate login in Online application system . 
 
HOW TO APPLY  
• From 03 November  2026 onwards, candidates have to register themselves online at POWERGRID 
website https://www.powergrid.in/ with details of their GATE 2026 registration number and 
other required information.  
• Online application shall close on 18 November 2026. 
• GATE Registration No.  and GATE Application  No. as appearing on the GATE  2026 Admit Card need 
to be entered carefully in the online application form. No other number should be entered as 
GATE 2026 Registration number  or GATE Application No. while applying. Application once 
submitted may be edited/updated till last date of submission of online application  
• Please note that once your application is submitted, no request regarding 
amendment/updation/ change in GATE Registration Number  or GATE Application No. or 
Name or any other details shall be entertained . Enter your name and other details  carefully 
and exactly as entered in your GATE admit card.   
• Please fill in  other details in the application very carefully. Please take care while filling out the 
email/ alternative email fields since all important communication shall be through emails only.  
• Upon completion, the candidate should submit the online application by clicking the Submit button 
at the end of the page. If the same is accepted, the system will generate a unique POWERGRID 
Registration Number which shall appear in the completed application form.  
 
 
Recruitment of E ngineer Trainee – GATE 202 6  Page 3 of 4 
 
POWERGRID strives to have a workforce which reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to 
apply. We have been recognized as one of Best Organizations for Women 202 6 by Economic Times 
 
• Candidates (Other than SC/ST/PwBD/Departmental) are required to pay Rs. 500/ - as non -
refundable application fee, through online Payment Gateway during the application period.  
 
• Application process will be treated as complete  only on submission of application fees  (as 
applicable ). 
• No hard copy of application is required to be sent to any address by post.  
• In-complete applications / Draft applications/ applications without application fees (if applicable) 
will be rejected.  
 
IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS : 
 
1. Candidates will have to upload their latest colour passport size photograph (.jpg file size not 
exceeding 50 kb), scanned copy of signature (.jpg file size not exceeding 30 kb), DOB proof 
certificate/ caste certificate/ disability certificate/ age relaxation cum domicile certificate and 
qualification final passing certificate  in Pdf format (final year appearing candidates to submit last 
semester/ year marksheet).  
 
2. Candidates will have to correctly declare their Name and Date of Birth as mentioned in their matric 
certificate. Candidates will have to declare their category correctly and must be in a position to 
submit relevant certificate in original as and when asked by POWERGRID.  
  
3. Candidates must correctly enter the qualification details including date of acquiring qualification as 
mentioned in their certificates.  
 
4. Candidates having degree in discipline other than those as mentioned in the above referred 
advertisement , are not eligible to apply. However, the Corporation reserves the right to take a final 
decision in considering an Engineering discipline eligible in case different from those mentioned 
above. 
 
5. After submission of application , candidate should take a printout  of the completed application and 
keep with her /him safely for future reference.  
 
6. If a candidate is called for GD and interview, her/ his identity  would be verified with GATE 2026 
admit card  and Original GATE  2026 score card . Therefore , candidates are requested to retain 
their GATE 2026 admit card and score card with them.  
 
7. Candidates shall be required to bring a valid photo ID  in original  to the interview. Photocopies of the 
original identification document will not be acceptable. Candidates will not be permitted  to appear 
for the group discussion and interview if original and valid photo identification is not presented 
along with the GATE 2026 admit card and score card.  
 
8. Application once submitted may be edited/updated till last date of submission of online 
application.  
 
9. It is mandatory that candidates go through the full text of the advertisement and agree to all the 
conditions given, while applying for the post.  
 
10. Please go through the section below carefully for details about payment of application fees.  
 
 
 
 
 
 
Recruitment of E ngineer Trainee – GATE 202 6  Page 4 of 4 
 
POWERGRID strives to have a workforce which reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to 
apply. We have been recognized as one of Best Organizations for Women 202 6 by Economic Times

Supreme Court of India SCI Court Assistant Technical Online Form 2026
 
SUPREME COURT OF INDIA

F.6/2026/Tech.Post/SC(RC)
Date: October 2, 2026.

ADVERTISEMENT

Online applications are invited from Indian citizens, who fulfill
the following qualifications and other eligibility conditions, as on *
October, 2026, for selection of suitable candidates by direct
recruitment for preparation of a panel for filling up 5 tentative
vacancies of Court Assistant (Technical Assistant-cum-
Programmer) (Group-B Non-Gazetted Post) placed in Level 7 of Pay
Matrix, i.e., Rs.44,900-Rs.,42,400/-, with initial Basic Pay of
Rs.44,900/-plus allowances,as admissible under the Rules.

The number of posts of Court Assistant (Technical Assistant-
cum-Programmer) may be subject to change, due to administrative
exigencies and/or the requirement of the Registry. The Registry
reserves the right to effect such change with the approval of the
competent Authority. The Registry also reserves the right to
cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify/alter the selection process, if need arises,
without issuing any notice. All rights regarding the selection process
are reserved with the competent Authority.

Qualifications, Experience and other Eligibility Conditions

e Bachelor of Engineering in Computer
Science/Information Technology or Bachelor of
Technology in Computer Science/Information
Technology from a recognized University or equivalent
with 3 years’ experience in software development.

OR

e Master’s Degree in Computer Application/M.Sc. in
Computer Science from a recognized University or
equivalent with 3 years’ experience in software
development.

Degree in Law from a recognized University will be
preferred and considered as an additional qualification.

 
OR

e B.Sc. in Computer Science/Bachelor in Computer
Application with First Class or atleast 60% marks in

Age Requirement

As on l* October, 2026, candidates should not be below 8 years
of age. The upper age limit for candidates is 35 years. However, usual
age relaxation will be admissible to the candidates belonging to
Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes (Non-
Creamy Layer), Physically Challenged and Ex-servicemen, as per the
Government of India’s Rules. Relaxation upto maximum of five years,
over and above the prescribed age limit, will be admissible to
dependants of freedom fighters. There will be no upper age limit for
the Departmental candidates of the Registry of the Supreme Court of
India. No relaxation in age will be allowed to the candidates working
in other Government Departments/Public Sector
Undertakings/Nationalized Banks, etc.

Reservation

The benefit of reservation will be in accordance with Rule 4A of
the Supreme Court Officers and Servants (Conditions of Service and
Conduct) Rules, 96].

Tests of the Examination:

Registration of application and payment of fee

Eligible candidates are required to apply online for which link
will be provided through the website of the Supreme Court of India,
viz., Www.sci.gov.in. The application will be accepted through online
registration only. Non-refundable — Application fee for
General/Unreserved category candidates is Rs.,500/- and, for
Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes/Other Backward Classes (Non-
Creamy Layer)/Ex-Servicemen/Physically Challenged candidates, is
Rs.750/-, plus Bank charges to be paid through online mode only. Fee
shall not be accepted in any other mode. No postal application form
shall be accepted. The fee shall be paid online through payment
gateway provided by UCO Bank.

While applying for the said post, a candidate will have to furnish
an Undertaking to the effect that he/she has read and understood the
terms and conditions mentioned in this Advertisement and he/she will
abide by the said terms and conditions, as also if any information
furnished by him/her is found incorrect/false, his/her candidature will
be cancelled without any notice to him/her.

24..2026, at .55 p.m.

General Instructions

l. The candidates applying for the post of Court Assistant (Technical
Assistant-cum-Programmer) should ensure that they fulfill the
prescribed qualification and other eligibility conditions for the
said post. Their admission at all the stages of Examination, viz.,
Objective Type Test, Objective Type Technical Aptitude Test,
Practical Aptitude Test and Interview will be purely provisional.
All requisite/relevant documents establishing their eligibility to
the post will be checked/verified at the time of document
verification process. If, on verification, at any time before or after
the said tests/interview, it is found that the candidate does not

 
fulfill the prescribed qualification or any of the eligibility
conditions, his/her candidature shall stand cancelled without any
notice.

At any stage of the recruitment process or otherwise, including
post-recruitment, if a candidate is or has been found guilty of
impersonation or has submitted fabricated or false documents or
has furnished false information/particulars with regard to his/her
qualification, category/caste and experience in the Application
Form or in any document or has misrepresented/suppressed any
material information ot has tampered with any document or has
made incorrect and false statement in the Application Form, or
has otherwise used or attempted support for his/her candidature
for securing appointment in the Registry of the Supreme Court of
India, he/she will be removed/disqualified, prosecuted and
debarred for future appointment in the Registry and_ his/her
application/appointment will be rejected/cancelled forthwith at
any stage of the recruitment process and/or while in service of the
Registry, i.e., during the period of probation and/or even after
confirmation of the service in the Registry.

The candidate will be required to upload the scanned copy of
his/her recent photograph, signature and requisite documents
(Class X", Class XII, Graduation and Experience Certificates,
caste/community certificate, in case of reserved category candidate,
and disability certificate, if applicable), while submitting online
Application Form in accordance with the instructions displayed on
the link provided for the purpose. Candidates should ensure that
all particulars are filled in the online Application Form and they
are correct in all respects before final submission of Application
Form. Application once submitted cannot be withdrawn or
modified.

The candidate shall make payment of fee online in accordance
with the instructions displayed on the link provided for the
purpose. They must note that fee once paid will not be refunded
under any circumstances or in any eventuality.

After successful completion of online Application Form, the
candidates will be able to preview their Application Form.
Candidates are advised to take printout of the filled up
Application Form for their records. Printout of filled up
Application Form need not be sent to the Registry.

The candidates should retain their Application number carefully
for generation of Admit Card from the link to be provided on the

विषय: उप प्रबंधक के विभिन्न पदों हेतु आयोजित कंप्यूटर आधाररत परीक्षा (CBT) के भिए आपवि दिज करने 
संबंधी भिंक। 
Subject: Objection Management Link for CBT Examination  for the various posts of               
Dy. Manager. 
 
यह दामोदर घाटी निगम (DVC) में उप प्रबंधक के विभिन्ि पदों पर िर्ती हेर्तु जारी विज्ञापि संख्या 
PLR/Lateral/02/2025/06 ददनांक 30.04.2025 के संदिभ में है। 
This is with reference to the Advertisement vide No. PLR/Lateral/02/2025/06                              
Dated 30.04.2025 for recruitment of the various posts of Dy. Manager in Damodar Valley 
Corporation (DVC). 
एर्तद्दद्दिारा सूचिर्त ककया जार्ता है कक ददिांक 11 अक्टूबर 2026 को आयोजजर्त कंप्यूटर आधाररत परीक्षा (CBT) 
के संबंध में अभ्यचथभयों द्दिारा अंककर्त उत्तर एिं उत्तर कुंजी (Answer Key) देखिे र्तथा आपवत्तयााँ दजभ करिे हेर्तु 
भ ंक सक्रिय (LIVE) कर ददया गया है, जो निधाभररर्त पोटभ  पर उप ब्ध है। 
It is hereby notified that the link for viewing the candidates’ responses and the answer key 
and for raising objections in respect of the Computer Based Test (CBT) conducted on                
11th October 2026 has been made LIVE and is accessible through the designated portal. 
अभ्यथी पोटभ  पर  ॉग-इि कर अपिे द्दिारा अंककर्त उत्तर एिं संबंचधर्त उत्तर कुंजी का अि ोकि कर सकर्ते 
हैं और यदद आिश्यक हो, र्तो निधाभररर्त अिचध के िीर्तर अपिी आपवत्तयााँ दजभ कर सकर्ते हैं। आपवत्त दजभ करिे 
हेर्तु भ ंक ददिांक 14.10.2026 से 16.10.2026 तक (रात्रि 23:59 बिे तक) सक्रिय (LIVE) रहेगा।  
Candidates may log in to the portal to review their responses and the corresponding answer 
key and, if required, submit objections within the stipulated period. The objection link shall 
remain LIVE from 14.10.2026 to 16.10.2026 (up to 23:59 hrs.).  
Scan to verify notice
 
 
 
 
परीक्षा प्रश्िपत्र के ककसी विभिष्ट प्रश्ि के विरुद्दध आपवत्त दजभ करािे के इच्छुक अभ्यथी उक्र्त भ ंक के माध्यम 
से अपिी आपवत्त प्रस्र्तुर्त कर सकर्ते हैं। आपवत्त प्रस्र्तुर्त करर्ते समय उसके समथभि में विस्र्तृर्त औचित्य PDF 
प्रारूप में अप ोड करिा अनििायभ होगा। 
Candidates who wish to raise objections against any specific question in the examination 
paper may submit the same through the link. A detailed justification for the objection must 
be uploaded in PDF format along with the submission. 
अभ्यचथभयों को निम्िभ खखर्त निदेिों का पा ि करिे की स ाह दी जार्ती है: 
Candidates are advised to: 
 
• ककसी िी आपवत्त को दजभ करिे से पूिभ संबंचधर्त प्रश्ि र्तथा अंककर्त उत्तर का सािधािीपूिभक परीक्षण कर 
 ें। Carefully assess the concerned question and the answer marked before raising 
any objection. 
• यह सुनिजश्िर्त करें कक आपवत्त के समथभि में प्रस्र्तुर्त औचित्य स्पष्ट, सटीक एिं उचिर्त दस्र्तािेजों द्दिारा 
प्रमाखणर्त हो। Ensure that the justification is clear, precise, and properly documented. 
निधाभररर्त समय-सीमा समाप्र्त होिे के पश्िार्त ककसी िी आपवत्त पर वििार िहीं ककया जाएगा। No objections shall 
be entertained after the stipulated deadline. 
यह सूििा सिी संबंचधर्त अभ्यचथभयों की जािकारी एिं आिश्यक कारभिाई हेर्तु जारी की जार्ती है।  
This notice is issued for the information and necessary action of all concerned candidates. 
 
 
 
DVC प्रतिभा अतिग्रहण टीम 
DVC Talent Acquisition Team

Instructions along with list of provisionally shortlisted candidates to 
appear for the CBT (Computer Based Test) Exam  
It is hereby informed to all candidates who have applied against the above-mentioned advertisement 
for the following posts: 
• Dy. Manager (Mechanical) - Post No. 2025/06 (For Erection) 
• Dy. Manager (Civil) - Post No. 2025/07 (For Construction) 
• Dy. Manager (Electrical) - Post No. 2025/08 (For Erection) 
• Dy. Manager (C&I) - Post No. 2025/09 (For Erection) 
• Dy. Manager (Safety) - Post No. 2025/10 
• Dy. Manager (Environment Management) - Post No. 2025/11 
 
सामान्य निर्देश/ GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS 
1. The list of candidates provisionally shortlisted for the Computer Based Test (CBT)  has been 
prepared on the basis of the credentials and information furnished by the candidates in their ONLINE 
Applications for the post of Dy. Manager in DVC. The provisional shortlisting of a candidate shall 
not confer any right upon him/her for appointment or continuation in the recruitment process. If, at 
any stage of the recruitment process, including after appointment or joining, it is found that any 
information furnished by the candidate is incorrect, incomplete, false or not in conformity with 
the eligibility criteria prescribed in the relevant Advertisement , or that the candidate has 
concealed, suppressed or distorted any material information , his/her candidature/appointment 
shall be liable to be cancelled/terminated without assigning any reason thereof. The candidate may 
also be liable for such further action as may be deemed appropriate by DVC.  
2. The details of the Computer Based Test (CBT) are: 
SL. NO. SCHEME OF COMPUTER BASED TEST (CBT) DETAILS 
1. Date of Computer Based Test (CBT) 11th October, 2026. 
2. Test Duration 120 Minutes (2 Hours). 
PATTERN OF EXAMINATION 
3. Domain Specific/Subject Related: Technical Knowledge 
Test (TKT) 
Subject related as per advertised 
posts. 
4. No. of Questions Technical Knowledge Test (TKT): 
75 Questions 
5. Weightage of Questions 50 Question s of 1 (One)  Mark 
each and 25 Questions of 2 
(Two) Marks each.  
 
 
Scan to verify notice
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Page 2 of 43  
6. Total Marks of CBT 100 Marks 
7. Negative Marking 1/4th of the marks assigned to a 
question shall be deducted for 
each wrong answer. 
8. Pattern of Examination The questions will be objective 
type and shall have 4 options of 
which one option shall be 
correct. 
9. Language of Question Paper The question paper will be 
bilingual i.e. both in English and 
Hindi 
 
 
3. The shortlisting of candidates is provisional. Final selection is subject to meeting all the requirements as 
laid down in the Advertisement and verification of all the required documents and credentials as furnished 
by the applicants in their ONLINE application.  
4. The Candidates qualifying in the CBT shall be called as per merit & fulfillment of other criteria for 
Document Verification followed by Personal Interview which shall be separately notified on the DVC 
Website only. 
5. The Computer Based Test (CBT) is only a qualifying stage of the recruitment process. Mere appearance 
in the CBT shall not confer any right upon a candidate to be called for Document Verification (DV) 
and/or Interview. Candidates shall be shortlisted for the subsequent stages of the recruitment process on 
the basis of the marks obtained in the CBT. 
6. Rights of DVC: DVC reserves the right to cancel the Notice/Advertisement at any stage. It may accept 
or reject any or all applications, without giving any reasons thereof, whatsoever.  
7. DVC shall not be responsible if the information/intimations do not reach candidates in case of change in 
the email address or technical fault or otherwise beyond the control of DVC. Candidates are, therefore, 
advised to visit DVC website www.dvc.gov.in (Recruitment Notices under Careers section) regularly for 
important and latest updates. 
8.  Any further notification, amendment, change of venue, date of CBT Exam followed by Document 
Verification & Interview etc. shall be notified on the DVC website www.dvc.gov.in  only. So, candidates 
are advised to visit DVC website (Recruitment Notices under Careers section) regularly for important 
updates. 
 
9. The following important guidelines may kindly be followed for appearing in Computer Based Test 
(CBT). 
 
a) The Admit Card shall be shortly made available only on the web site https://www.dvc.gov.in for 
downloading & printing by the candidates. This Admit Card is computer generated and shall not be sent 
by post. 
b) The Admit Card will be valid only for the Test date and Time as specified in the Admit Card. 
c) No request for change in the test date, time and allotted T est Centre will be considered under any 
circumstances. 
d) The decision of the Management will be final and binding on all candidates on all matters relating to the 
eligibility, acceptance or rejection of the applications, mode of selection, cancellation of the recruitment 
process, etc. and no enquiry/correspondence will be entertained in this regard. 
e) Mere appearing or shortlisted for appearing in the Computer Based Test (CBT) does not bestow upon the 
applicant any right to be selected Suo-moto to the post applied for. 
f) No Traveling Expenses will be reimbursed for appearing in the Computer Based Test. No other 
allowances, local transportation, taxi fare, etc., shall be admissible for attending the test. 
g) The candidate will have to make his/her own arrangements for his/her boarding and lodging at the place 
of Computer Based Test.  
h) Any subsequent amendment/notice/clarification etc. will be made available in DVC website only. As 
such, applicants are advised to keep visiting DVC website www.dvc.gov.in from time to time.

Section 1: Engineering Mathematics 
     Linear Algebra: Matrix algebra, systems of linear equations, eigenvalues and eigenvectors. 
Calculus: Functions of single variable, limit, continuity and differentiability, mean value theorems, 
indeterminate forms; evaluation of definite and improper integrals; double and triple integrals; partial 
derivatives, total derivative, Taylor series (in one and tw o variables), maxima and minima, Fourier series;  
gradient, divergence and curl, vector identities, directional derivatives, line, surface and volume integrals, 
applications of Gauss, Stokes and Green’s theorems. 
Differential Equations: First order equations (linear and nonlinear); higher order linear differential equations 
with constant coefficients; Euler -Cauchy equation; initial and boundary value problems; Laplace transforms; 
solutions of heat, wave and Laplace's equations. 
Complex Variables: Analytic functions; Cauchy-Riemann equations; Cauchy’s integral theorem and 
integral formula; Taylor and Laurent series. 
Probability and Statistics: Definitions of probability, sampling theorems, conditional probability; mean, median, 
mode and standard deviation; random variables, binomial, Poisson and normal distributions. 
Numerical Methods : Numerical solutions of linear and non -linear algebraic equations; integration by 
trapezoidal and Simpson’s rules; single and multi-step methods for differential equations. 
Section 2: Applied Mechanics and Design 
Engineering Mechanics: Free-body diagrams and equilibrium; friction and its applications including rolling 
friction, belt -pulley, brakes, clutches, screw jack, wedge, vehicles, etc.; trusses and frames; virtual  work; 
kinematics and dynamics of rigid bodies in plane motion; impulse and momentum (linear and angular) and 
energy formulations; Lagrange’s equation. 
Mechanics of Materials: Stress and strain, elastic constants, Poisson's ratio; Mohr’s circle for plane stress and 
plane strain; thin cylinders; shear force and bending moment diagrams; bending and shear stresses; concept of 
shear centre; deflection of beams; torsion of circular shafts; Euler’s theory of columns; energy methods; thermal 
stresses; strain gauges and rosettes; testing of materials with universal testing machine; testing of hardness and 
impact strength. 
Theory of Machines: Displacement, velocity and acceleration analysis of plane mechanisms; dynamic analysis 
of linkages; cams; gears and gear trains; flywheels and governors; balancing of reciprocating and rotating 
masses; gyroscope. 
Vibrations: Free and forced vibration of single degree of freedom systems, effect of damping; vibration isolation; 
resonance; critical speeds of shafts. 
Machine Design: Design for static and dynamic loading; failure theories; fatigue strength and the S-N diagram; 
principles of the design of machine elements such as bolted, riveted and welded joints; shafts, gears, rolling and 
sliding contact bearings, brakes and clutches, springs.

Fluid Mechanics: Fluid properties; fluid statics, forces on submerged bodies, stability of floating bodies; 
control-volume analysis of mass, momentum and energy; fluid acceleration; differential equations of 
continuity and momentum; Bernoulli’s equation; dimensional analysis; viscous flow of incompressible fluids, 
boundary layer, elementary turbulent flow, flow through pipes, head losses in pipes, bends and fittings; basics 
of compressible fluid flow. 
Heat Transfer: Modes of heat transfer; one dimensional heat conduction, resistance concept and electrical 
analogy, heat transfer through fins; unsteady heat conduction, lumped parameter system, Heisler's  charts; 
thermal boundary layer, dimensionless parameters in free and forced convective heat transfer, heat transfer 
correlations for flow over flat plates and through pipes, effect of turbulence; heat exchanger performance, LMTD 
and NTU methods; radiative heat transfer, Stefan - Boltzmann law, Wien's displacement law, black and grey 
surfaces, view factors, radiation network analysis 
Thermodynamics: Thermodynamic systems and processes; properties of pure substances, behaviour of ideal 
and real gases; zeroth and first laws of thermodynamics, calculation of work and heat in various processes; 
second law of thermodynamics; thermodynamic property  charts and  tables, availability and irreversibility; 
thermodynamic relations. 
Applications: Power Engineering: Air and gas compressors; vapor and gas power cycles, concepts of 
regeneration and reheat. I.C. Engines: Air-standard Otto, Diesel and dual cycles. Refrigeration and air-
conditioning: Vapor and gas refrigeration and heat pump cycles; properties of moist air, psychrometric chart, 
basic psychrometric processes. Turbomachinery: Impulse and reaction principles, velocity diagrams, Pelton -
wheel, Francis and Kaplan turbines; steam and gas turbines. 
Section 4: Materials, Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering 
Engineering Materials: Structure and properties of engineering materials, phase diagrams, heat treatment, stress-
strain diagrams for engineering materials. 
Casting, Forming and Joining Processes : Different types of castings, design of patterns, moulds and cores; 
solidification and cooling; riser and gating design. Plastic deformation and yield criteria; fundamentals of hot and 
cold working processes; load estimation for bulk (forging, rolling, extrusion, drawing) and sheet (shearing, deep 
drawing, bending) metal forming processes; principles of powder metallurgy. Principles of welding, brazing, 
soldering and adhesive bonding. 
Machining and Machine Tool Operations : Mechanics of machining; basic machine tools; single and multi -
point cutting tools, tool geometry and materials, tool life and wear; economics of machining; principles  of non-
traditional machining processes; principles of work holding, jigs and fixtures; abrasive machining processes; 
NC/CNC machines and CNC programming. 
Metrology and Inspection:  Limits, fits and tolerances; linear and angular measurements; comparators; 
interferometry; form and finish measurement; alignment and testing methods; tolerance analysis in manufacturing 
and assembly; concepts of coordinate-measuring machine (CMM). 
Computer Integrated Manufacturing: Basic concepts of CAD/CAM and their integration tools; additive 
manufacturing. 
Production Planning and Control : Forecasting models, aggregate production planning, scheduling, materials 
requirement planning; lean manufacturing. 
Inventory Control: Deterministic models; safety stock inventory control systems.

दामोदर घाटी निगम/Damodar Valley Corporation 
मािव संसाधि ववभाग/ Human Resource Department 
डीवीसी टावसस,  वीआईपी रोड,कोलकाता-700054/ 
DVC Towers, VIP Road, Kolkata –700054 
     ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------                         
 ददिांक Date:  15/09/2026 
 
 दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन में उपस्थित होने क े  लिए अनंलतम रूप से चुने गए उम्मीदवारों की सूची पैरामेडिकल स्टाफ 
(अनुबंध क े  आधार पर) 
Provisionally Shortlisted Candidates for Document Verification for the Posts of Paramedical 
Staff (Contractual Basis) 
__________________________________________________________ 
संदर्भ: लवज्ञापन सं. पीएलआर/संडिदात्मक/01/2025/10 डदनांक 19/06/2025 
Ref:  Advt. No. PLR/Contractual/01/2025/10 Date:19/06/2025 
 
क ृ पया दस्तावेजों क े  सत्यापन क े  लिए उपस्थित होने से पहिे लनम्नलिस्थित लदशालनदेश पढें। The following 
guidelines may kindly be read before appearing for documents verification. 
1.  अंलतम चयन प्रासंलगक लवज्ञापन में लनर्ाभररत सर्ी आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने और आवेदक द्वारा अपने 
ऑनिाइन आवेदन में प्रस्तुत सर्ी आवश्यक दस्तावेजों क े  सत्यापन क े  अर्ीन हैं। 
      Final selection are subject to meeting all requirements as laid down in the relevant 
advertisement and verification of all the required documents furnished by the applicant in 
his/her ONLINE application.  
 
2. लजन उम्मीदवारों क े  नाम शॉर्भलिस्ट लकए गए हैं, उन्हें लवज्ञापन में लनर्ाभररत अपेलित पात्रता मानदंडों को पूरा 
करने क े  अर्ीन उपरोक्त पद क े  लिए ऑनिाइन आवेदन में उनक े  द्वारा की गई प्रलवलियों क े  आर्ार पर दस्तावेज़ 
सत्यापन क े  लिए अनंलतम रूप से बुिाया जाएगा।. यलद र्ती प्रलिया क े  लकसी र्ी चरण में र्ती या शालमि होने 
क े  बाद, यह पाया जाता है लक उसक े  द्वारा प्रदान की गई जानकारी गित / अपूणभ / झूठी है या प्रासंलगक लवज्ञापन 
/ अलर्सूचना में लनर्ाभररत पात्रता मानदंडों क े  अनुरूप नहीं है, या यलद यह पाया जाता है लक उसने लकसी र्ी 
सामग्री की जानकारी लिपाई / लवक ृ त की है, उसकी उम्मीदवारी / लनयुस्थक्त को लबना कोई कारण बताए रद्द 
कर लदया जाएगा। 
The candidates  whose names are shortlisted will be provisionally called for  Document 
Verification  (DV) based on the entries made by them in the ONLINE application for the 
above post subject to fulfilling the requisite eligibility criteria as stipulated in the 
Advertisement. If at any stage of the recruitment process including after recruitment or 
joining, it is detected that information provided by him/her is incorrect/incomplete/false or 
is not in conformity with the eligibility criteria as prescribed in the relevant 
Advertisement/Notification, or if it is found that he/she has concealed/distorted any material 
information, his/her candidature/appointment will be can celled without assigning any 
reason thereof. 
 
 
Scan to verify notice
 
 
 
 
 
 
2 
 
3. जबलक अनंलतम रूप से पात्र आवेदकों की सूची तैयार करने में हर सावर्ानी बरती गई है, दामोदर घार्ी लनगम 
लकसी तथ्य-आर्ाररत अनजाने में हुई त्रुलर् अथवा र्ंकण संबंर्ी गिती को सुर्ारने का अपना अलर्कार सुरलित 
रिता है। 
     While every care has been taken in preparing the list of provisionally eligible applicants, DVC 
reserves its right to rectify any fact-based inadvertent error or typographical mistake. 
 
4. दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन क े  लिए चुने आवेदकों 5 व ीं मींजजल, डीवीसी र्ावसभ, वीआईपी रोड (उल्टाडांगा क े  पास), 
कोिकाता -700054 में उस्थिस्थित लववरण क े  अनुसार आयोलजत लकया जाएगा । 
      Document verification of the shortlisted applicants will be held a t 5th Floor , DVC Towers, 
VIP Road (Near Ultadanga), Kolkata-700054 . 
 
5. दस्तावेजों क े  सत्यापन क े  बाद व्यस्थक्तगत सािात्कार (पीआई) क े  समय मूि रूप से स्व-सत्यालपत फोर्ोकॉपी 
क े  एक सेर् क े  साथ अलनवायभ रूप से िाए जाने वािे दस्तावेजों की सूची: - 
      List of Documents to be brought mandatorily at the time of Document Verification followed 
by Personal Interview (PI) in ORIGINAL with one set of self -attested PHOTOCOPIES 
positively: - 
 
a) ऑन-िाइन आवेदन पत्र का लप्रंर्आउर्। Printout of On-Line Application Form.       
b) क ं प्यूर्र आर्ाररत परीिा (सीबीर्ी) क े  लिए जारी लकए गए प्रवेश पत्र की प्रलत/ Copy of Admit Card issued 
for Computer Based Test (CBT) 
c)  जन्म लतलथ का प्रमाण (किा दसवीं बोडभ प्रमाणपत्र या स्क ू ि िोड़ने का प्रमाण पत्र या किा दसवीं पालसंग      
सलर्भलफक े र्)। Proof of Date of Birth (Class Xth Board Certificate or School Leaving Certificate 
or Class Xth Passing Certificate). 
d) किा 10वीं और 12वीं की अंक तालिका  और प्रमाण पत्र।  लडग्री या लडप्लोमा आलद क े  वैर् प्रमाण पत्र और 
अंक तालिका  (सेमेस्टर -वार) / Valid Certificates & Mark sheets  of Class Xth, XIIth, 
Diploma/Degree Certificate   (semester-wise/year -wise). 
e) उच्च योग्यता का प्रमाण (यदि कोई हो)। Proof of Higher Qualification (if any). 
f) अनुभव प्रमाण पत्र यथा प्रयोज्य । Experience Certificate(s), wherever applicable. 
         कार्य अनुभव में आपक े  वर्यमान सींगठन में आर्ोजजर् नौकर  कर्यव्ोीं और जजम्मेदाररर्ोीं उिास्थित होना चालहए   
जकर्ा जाना चाजिए/ Work experience must contain Job duties and responsibilities held at your 
current organization.  
g) इंटर्नशिप पूर्नता प्रमार् पत्र, यथा प्रयोज्य । Internship Completion Certificate, wherever 
applicable.  
h) वैध पंजीकरण प्रमाण पत्र, यथा प्रयोज्य / Valid Registration Certificate, wherever applicable. 
वर्यमान जनर्ोक्ता से अनापजि प्रमाण पत्र (एनओस ) र्जद सावयजजनक क्षेत्र क े  उपक्रम/क ें द्र सरकार/राज्य 
सरकार/अर्य-सरकार  / आजद में काम कर रिे िैं। 
i) No-Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer if working in a PSU/Central 
Govt./State Govt./Semi-Govt./etc. 
j) एससी/एसर्ी/ओबीसी (एनसीएि)/ ईडब्ल्यूएस वैर् प्रमाण पत्र (लनर्ाभररत प्रारूप में), यलद िागू हो।/Valid SC/ 
ST/ OBC (NCL)/EWS (in the prescribed format), if applicable. 
 
 
Scan to verify notice
 
 
 
 
 
 
3 
 
k) चार (4) हाि ही में पासपोर्भ आकार क े  रंगीन फोर्ो लवलर्वत स्व-प्रमालणत। 
     Four (4) recent passport size colored photographs duly self-attested.  
l) कोई एक फोर्ो पहचान प्रमाण (पैन काडभ/पासपोर्भ/ड र ाइलवंग िाइसेंस/वोर्र आईडी काडभ/ आर्ार काडभ)। 
     Any one Photo Identity Proof (PAN card/ Passport/ Driving License/ Voter ID card/  
      Aadhar Card).    
m) लकसी अन्य अलतररक्त योग्यता क े  समथभन में दस्तावेज / ऑनिाइन आवेदन में उस्थिस्थित अनुर्व। 
     Documents / Certificates in support of any other additional qualification/ experience  
mentioned in the online application. 
 
6.  दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन क े  लिए क े वि उपस्थित होने या शॉर्भलिस्ट करने से आवेदक को आवेदन लकए गए पद क े     
     लिए स्वतः  चुने जाने का कोई अलर्कार नहीं लमिता है। 
     Mere appearing or shortlisting for the Document Verification does not bestow upon the 
applicant  any right to be selected suo moto to the post applied for. 
 
7. यलद आवेदक उपरोक्त िम संख्या 5 क े  तहत उस्थिस्थित सर्ी आवश्यक दस्तावेज/प्रमाण पत्र मूि रूप में िाने 
में लवफि रहता है या यलद दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन क े  समय, यह पाया जाता है लक आवेदक द्वारा प्रदान लकया गया 
दस्तावेज / प्रमाण पत्र गित / अपूणभ / गित है या लवज्ञापन में उस्थिस्थित पात्रता मानदंडों क े  अनुरूप नहीं है, या 
यलद यह पाया जाता है लक उसने लकसी र्ी सामग्री की जानकारी को ि ु पाया / लवक ृ त लकया है, तो आवेदक को 
सािात्कार क े  लिए उपस्थित होने की अनुमलत नहीं दी जाएगी। 
    If applicant fail to bring all the required documents/certificates in original as mentioned under 
SL. No. 5 above  or if at the time of document verification, it is detected that 
document/certificate provided by the applicant is incorrect/incomplete/false or is not in 
conformity with the eligibility criteria as mentioned in the advertisement, or if it is found that 
he/she has concealed/distorted any material information, the applicant shall not be 
allowed to appear for Interview. 
8.   दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन में भाग लेने के जलए र्ात्रा (ट ए / ड ए) के प्रजर् कोई खचय नि ीं जदर्ा जाएगा। 
No expenses towards travelling (TA/DA) will be given for attending the Document Verification. 
9.  उम्मीदवार की पात्रता की पुलि दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन  की लतलथ पर दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन क े  बाद की जाएगी। 
    The eligibility of the candidate for the will be confirmed after document verification on the 
said date of DV. 
 
10. उम्मीदवारों को रहने क े  लिए अपनी व्यविा करनी चालहए यलद दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन  अगिे लदन जारी रहता है। 
   Candidates should make their own arrangements for staying if the Document Verification 
continues on the next day.  
 
11. बाद में कोई संशोर्न/नोलर्स/स्पिीकरण आलद क े वि डीवीसी वेबसाइर् पर उपिब्ध कराया जाएगा। इस 
प्रकार, उम्मीदवारों को सिाह दी जाती है लक वे पद की र्ती प्रलिया पूरी होने तक समय -समय पर 
www.dvc.gov.in डीवीसी वेबसाइर् पर जाते रहें। 
     Any subsequent amendment/notice/clarification etc. will be made available in DVC website 
only. As such, candidates are advised to keep visiting DVC website www.dvc.gov.in from 
time to time till completion of recruitment process of the post.

NOTICE FOR ENGAGEMENT OF  EMPLOYEES ON FULL-TIME CONTRACTUAL BASIS IN DCPPL 
 
डीवीसी सीआईएल पावर प्राइवेट लललिटेड (डीसीपीपीएल), दािोदर वैली कॉपोरेशन (भारत की संलवधान सभा द्वारा अलधलनयि संख्या XIV, 1948 
के अंतर्गत स्थालपत एक वैधालनक लनकाय) तथा कोल इंलडया लललिटेड (कोयला िंत्रालय के अधीन एक िहारत्न क ें द्रीय सावगजलनक क्षेत्र उपक्रि) की 
50:50 भार्ीदारी वाली संयुक्त उद्यि (Joint Venture) क ं पनी है। डीसीपीपीएल, डीवीसी के वतगिान चंद्रपुरा ताप लवद ् युत स्टेशन (CTPS) पररसर 
िें ब्राउनफील्ड लवस्तार पररयोजना के रूप िें 2×800 िेर्ावाट अल्ट् र ा-सुपरलक्रलटकल तापीय लवद ् युत पररयोजना, अथागत डीवीसी-सीआईएल चंद्रपुरा 
ताप लवद ् युत स्टेशन (DC-CTPS) स्थालपत कर रही है। 
 अपने कायगबल को सुदृढ़ बनाने तथा लवस्ताररत पररचालन र्लतलवलधयों को प्रभावी ढंर् से सिथगन प्रदान करने के उद्देश्य से, डीसीपीपीएल लनम्नललखित 
लवलभन्न लवषयों/लवभार्ों क ं सल्टेंट / वरिष्ठ क ं सल्टेंट / सलाहकाि / वरिष्ठ सलाहकाि के पदों हेतु योग्य, अनुभवी, ऊजागवान एवं पररणािोन्मुिी 
पेशेवरों से आवेदन आिंलत्रत करता है। क ं पनी एक तीव्र र्लत से लवकलसत हो रहे एवं प्रर्लतशील संर्ठन िें क ै ररयर उन्नलत, व्यावसालयक लवकास तथा 
दीर्गकाललक प्रर्लत के उत्क ृ ष्ट अवसर प्रदान करती है। 
DVC CIL Power Private Limited (DCPPL)" is a 50:50 shareholding Joint Venture Company of Damodar 
Valley Corporation (a statutory body incorporated by the Constituent Assembly of India's Act No. XIV of 
1948) and Coal India Limited (a Maharatna CPSE under Min istry of Coal).  DCPPL is setting up 2x800 
MW Ultra-supercritical Thermal Power Plant DVC-CIL Chandrapura Thermal Power Station (DC-CTPS) 
at the DVC's existing Chandrapura TPS as a brownfield expansion project.   
To strengthen its workforce and support its expanding operations, DCPPL invites applications from 
qualified, experienced, and result -oriented professionals for the following positions in various 
disciplines of Consultant / Senior Consultant/ Advisor/ Senior Advisor. The Company offers excellent 
opportunities for career advancement, professional growth, and long -term development in a fast -
growing and progressive organization.

डीवीसी में वरिष्ठ ववशेषज्ञ पर सेवानिवृत्त कमसचाररयों के ललए सूचिा 
NOTICE FOR ENGAGEMENT OF RETIRED EMPLOYEES AS EXPERT IN DVC 
 
दामोदर घाटी निगम (डीवीसी) की स्थापिा वर्ष 1948 में झारखंड एवं पश्चिम बंगाल राज्यों में 24,235 वगष 
ककलोमीटर में ववस्ताररत दामोदर घाटी क्षेत्र के समग्र ववकास के ललए की गई थी।  डीवीसी का मुख्यालय 
कोलकाता में श्स्थत है और इसकी व्यावसानयक गनतववधियां मुख्य रूप से उत्पादि, पारेर्ण और ववतरण, 
खिि, जल संसािि प्रबंिि और मृदा संरक्षण हैं । इसका मुख्य व्यवसाय सीएसआर िीनतयों के साथ अच्छी 
तरह से एकीकृत है श्जसका उद्देचय घाटी का दीघषकाललक सामाश्जक-आधथषक ववकास करिा है। डीवीसी िवीि 
पयाषवरण अिुकूल प्रौद्योधगककयों के साथ ववलिन्ि ऊजाष स्रोतों के उपयोग को अिुकूललत कर स्थायी पद्िनत 
से प्रनतस्पिी कीमतों पर ववचवसिीय ववद्युत उत्पाददत कर राष्ट्र के ववकास में योगदाि देिे में प्रनतबद्ि है । 
 
Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC) was created in the year 1948 for the holistic development of the 
Damodar valley area spread across 24,235 square km in the States of Jharkhand and West Bengal. 
DVC Head Quarter is located at Kolkata and its business activities are primarily: CSR, Transmission 
& Distribution, Mining, Water Resources Management, and Soil Conservation. It’s core business is 
well integrated with the CSR policies aimed at creating long -term socio-economic development of 
the valley. DVC is committed to generating relia ble power at competitive prices in a sustainable 
manner by optimising the use of multiple energy sources with innovative eco -friendly technologies 
thereby contributing to the growth of the nation. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Page 2 of 11 
 
 
 
 
 
तापीय, हाइडल एवं िवीकरणीय स्रोतों तथा संबंधित ववतरण प्रणाललयों से 6700 मेगावाट से अधिक की अपिी 
वतषमाि स्थावपत क्षमता से, डीवीसी एक एकीकृत ववद्युत प्रमुख बििे की ओर अग्रसर है और 2030 तक 15 
गीगावॉट कॉपोरेशि बििे का लक्ष्य रखता है। क्षमता संविषि हेतु व्यापक एवं वववविीकृत ववकास योजिा के 
मद्देिजर, डीवीसी की आवचयकताओं के आिार पर क ें द्र / राज्य सरकार के संगठिों / सावषजनिक क्षेत्र के 
उपक्रमों / स्वायत्त और सांववधिक निकायों / राष्ट्रीय / राज्य स्तरीय व्यावसानयक संस्थािों / निजी संगठिों / 
वैज्ञानिक और अिुसंिाि संस्थािों से सेवानिवृत्त कमषिाररयों से डीवीसी में पूणषकाललक संववदा आिार पर 
ऑिलाइि आवेदि आमंत्रत्रत करिे के ललए तत्पर है। 
 
From its present installed capacity of over 6700 MW from Thermal, Hydel and Renewable sources 
and associated distribution systems, DVC is steering ahead to be an integrated power major and 
targets to become a 15 GW Corporation by 2030. In view of the exten sive and diversified growth 
plan for capacity addition, DVC looks forward to  invite ONLINE applications from 
Retired employees From Central/ State Government Organizations / Public Sector 
Undertakings/ Autonomous & Statutory bodies/ National/State Level Professional 
Institutions/ Private Organisations/ Scientific & Research Institutions based on requirements 
of DVC.

The engagement does not confer any claim on the selected candidate for regular appointment in 
DVC.

कोई अन्य माध्यम/तरीका स्वीकार िहीं ककया जाएगा। 
 
MODE OF APPLICATION: Interested and Eligible candidates shall have to apply only through 
ONLINE registration system of DVC. To apply log on to the DVC website www.dvc.gov.in →Careers→ 
Recruitment→ Recruitment Notices. The online registrations will remain activated from 07/09/2026 to 
23:59 hrs of 27/09/2026. No other means/mode of application shall be accepted.

को पूरा करते हैं। 
Before applying ONLINE, applicants are advised to read the detailed Advertisement/Notice 
carefully and must ensure that they fulfil the essential qualification, experience and other conditions 
as mentioned in the Notice.

items.title: Ranbir Kapoor
items.doc_text: News movies bollywood Ranbir Kapoor To Dethrone Ranveer Singh? Ramayana's Rs 4000-Cr Gamble Eyes History With Rs 150-Cr Opening Ranbir Kapoor To Dethrone Ranveer Singh? Ramayana's Rs 4000-Cr Gamble Eyes History With Rs 150-Cr Opening Written By : Titas Chowdhury , News18.com Last Updated: November 03, 2026, 07:47 IST Ahead of its release, trade experts share why they feel Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana may shatter records despite mixed USA reviews, slower buzz and solid competition in south India. 3 Quick Answers Rapid Read Summarized by AI. + More Rapid Read Like this summary? Share Your Feedback Got Question about the News? 3 Quick Answers Ramayana: Rise Of A Legend is all set for a worldwide theatrical release on November 5. All eyes are set on Nitesh Tiwari and Namit Malhotra’s Ramayana: Rise Of A Legend starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash! Let’s quickly look at the figures here… The two-part epic adaptation is built on an estimated budget of Rs 4000 crore. The first part is set to release across 59000 screens worldwide across Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam and English languages. With so much riding on Ramayana, the pressure on the film is immense. The makers had mounted an unprecedented global promotional campaign. Beyond its box-office prospects, it carries the responsibility of bringing one of India’s most revered epics to a global audience while meeting the expectations of generations familiar with the story. Recommended Stories Despite the scale of the ambition, Ramayana faced considerable negativity even before its theatrical release. The first glimpse and subsequent trailer drew criticism over the visual effects, with Ranbir and Sai’s casting triggering debates. More recently, early reactions following its premiere in Los Angeles have been divided over the screenplay, pacing, VFX and background score. We exclusively speak to trade gurus and analysts, who weigh in on their thoughts on whether Ramayana can break records or crumble under its own lofty ambitions. Will Ramayana Roar Its Way Into 100Cr Club On Day 1? The presale figures has surpassed Rs 50 crore gross across India. Maharashtra leads state-wise pre-sales, followed by Delhi and Karnataka. But many believe that the hype isn’t necessarity converting to advance booking s in the way it should. As of November 2, Ramayana lagged significantly behind Yash’s last release Toxic: A Fairy Tale For Grown-Ups in pre-sales. Chennai-based trade analyst Ramesh Bala predicts a solid opening with Karnataka contributing a big chunk. “I expect Ramayana to mint around Rs 100-150 crore on day one in India (largely contributed by current bookings). North India will contribute a large percentage of its box office collections with Karnataka following second," he says. At A Glance 1 . The two-part epic adaptation Ramayana: Rise Of A Legend is built on an estimated budget of Rs 4000 crore. 2 . Trade analyst Ramesh Bala predicts Ramayana will mint around Rs 100-150 crore on day one in India. 3 . Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar: The Revenge grossed over Rs 1800 crore worldwide and recorded an India nett of Rs 102.55 crore on day one. 4 . As of Monday, advance bookings for Ramayana in Karnataka stand at Rs 3 crore. Show More Exhibitor Akkshay Rathie believes Ramayana ‘can create history’. “Yash’s stardom will push Karnataka to fire in a big way. With the ticket rates and the anticipation that’s there at ground level, it has the potential to go beyond Rs 100 crores on day one. It has the intrinsic potential and value to become the highest-grossing Indian film of all time," he tells us. Veteran trade expert Taran Adarsh has already experienced this magnum opus on the big screen. In his words, it’ll emerge as the ‘highest pre-Diwali opener of all time’. “Sky is the limit. There’s no stopping this film. It has grandeur and soul. I’m very confident Ramayana will do well. It will shatter all records. More screens are being added as we speak," he remarks. Film business expert Girish Johar, however, shares a different perspective. “It may have a slow start like Dhurandhar. Its business will peak only post-Diwali. As per initial industry reports, the film’s outstanding. But what makes me a little flummoxed is, why they’re releasing the film on a Thursday. It’s not a holiday either in India or overseas. I’m predicting Rs 50 crore in India," he opines. LA’s Mixed Verdict To Dent Ramayana’s Home Run? Adarsh doesn’t believe so. “They’ve watched the English version. It’s 35-40 minutes lesser than the Indian version. That’s a very different audience anyway," he asserts. Johar agrees with Adarsh, reiterating that what the Ramayana means to us is vastly different from what it means to those in the West. “They’re probably watching another Lord Of The Rings. But we’ll be watching divinity, mythology and the ethos we’ve been brought up on while watching it," he remarks. But Bala feels that the reviews coming from the West will ‘certainly’ have an impact on its domestic box office collections. “Negative stories gets amplified on social media faster than positive ones," he states. “I hope we’re able to watch it with an open mind. But the LA premiere hasn’t been able to give any push to Ramayana. People in India haven’t rushed to book their tickets yet. I’m staying optimistic but cautiously. But since Yash’s performance is being praised, I hope it translates to footfalls in Karnataka," he further adds. Can Ranbir Dethrone Ranveer? Dhurandhar: The Revenge starring Ranveer Singh grossed over Rs 1800 crore worldwide and emered as the highest-grossing Hindi film of 2026. It went on to set several other new records. On its day one, its India nett stood at Rs 102.55 crore across all languages, according to Sacnilk. So, can Ramayana surpass Dhurandhar: The Revenge and create history? For the unversed, the combined production budget of Dhurandhar and Dhurandhar: The Revenge was around Rs 250 crore against Ramayana’s Rs 4000 crore budget. For Bala, beating the Aditya Dhar directorial won’t be an easy feat. “I hope Ramayana outdoes Dhurandhar: The Revenge to recover its budget but it won’t be easy," he points out. He adds, “Dhurandhar has set a very high benchmark in the Hindi-speaking markets. For that to happen, Ramayana has to perform well in the overseas market too. The former ran house-full for four weeks. It had a repeat value too. We’ll have to wait and watch if Ramayana has a repeat value." But Rathie’s confident that the Ranbir-starrer will emerge victorious out of the two. “In terms of the nett revenues, it has the potential to go beyond Dhurandhar. It has the ability to capture the imagination of the people at large in a manner that no other Indian film has been able to till date. Namit Malhotra is the interior designer of Ramayana but the architect is still Nitesh Tiwari . In terms of the elements in the mix, it has the potential to go beyond Dhurandhar 2," he explains. The South Snag Bala explains that unlike ‘Yash’s homeground’ Karnataka where Ramayana is set to fly solo, it’ll face significant competition in Tamil Nadu and Kerala. “Karnataka leads the buzz. The advance booking has begun for the premium format (IMAX) and some 2D formats. The presales in Karnataka stands at Rs 3 crore (as of Monday). It will lead collections in the south belt," he says. “In Chennai, I see advance bookings in IMAX doing well. In Tamil Nadu, Suriya’s Scene and Nayanthara’s Mookuthi Amman 2 will give competition to Ramayana. In Kerala, it will be a two-way race between Ramayana and Scene. In Karnataka, however, Ramayana will have an advantage because of Yash. In the Telugu-speaking states, Venkatesh’s Aadardha Kutumbam’s doing well," he adds. He points out that the advance booking for Ramayana in south is ‘nothing like a Rajinikanth or an Allu Arjun film’. “In north India, Hindutva films tend to do well. But in south, content overpowers sentiments and fervour. I think Ramayana will pick up on the weekend if word-of-mouth is positive. Needless to say, it’ll fare better in north because of the Ayodhya sentiment." items.doc_text: Key Verticals Generating highly skilled & certified Cyber Security Professionals-CISOs Grooming students towards products and solutions development in cyber security Strengthening research & education in Advance ememerging area of Information Security Cyber Aware Digital Naagrik (Mass Awareness) Common Infrastructure & Shared Resources Grooming students towards products and solutions development in cybersecurity Bootcamps Hackathons Innovation Challenges Mentorship Strengthening Research & Educations Chief Information Security Officer (CISOs) Training & Certifications A robust mechanism for training and certification of CISOs to develop highly skilled and capable cyber security professionals. Training specialization under 13 domains of knowledge & skilling. Strategized scheme for Re-certification of professionals. Building Cyber-Aware Digital Naagrik Role-based Awareness & Progression Pathways Digital naagrik or citizen are people who are actively engaged in the digital world for their day to day activities. Proliferate Mass Awareness on Cyber Hygiene and Cyber Security Cybersecurity awareness involves consistently educating individuals about emerging threats and imparting knowledge on preventive measures. User Engagement Programs User Engagement Program in role-based learning is an initiative that allows participants to learn and understand cyber hygiene practices in simulated cyber scenarios. Awareness Bytes Excited Knowledge quest in cyber security awareness activities Common Infrastructure & Shared Resources Register The four verticals of ISEA would be supported by Common Infrastructure & Shared Resources to synergize and proliferate ISEA activities on a national scale. The ISEA Virtual Platform (IVP) is envisaged to provide access to ISEA resources,content, courses etc. to various end-users and stakeholders. This platform is having inter-connectivity to common infrastructure & shared resources through a layer.

belongs to category SC/ST/OBC/EWS (Non-General Category) and Physically Challenged 
(PC) are exempted from the said Application Fee, but shall have to pay Rs.100/- as ‘Application

7. Candidate(s) presently working/engaged with any WII’s project or research activity or Ph.D. 
scholars must attach  a recent “NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE ” (not more than one month 
older than la st date of application) from their concerned Project Investigator/Supervisor/ Nodal 
Officer, as the case may be. Similarly, the candidate earlier worked at WII has to produce ‘No 
Dues’ certificate obtained from WII. 
 
8. Shortlisting of applicants for online i nterview will be based on essential qualification, age limit, 
percentage of marks in Bachelor’s/ Master’s Degree, specialization relevance in Masters, research 
experience and (Publications- Paper published in journals, books Paper Presented in Workshops/ 
Seminars/ Symposiums/Conferences), as per WII rules.

below: 
 
% Marks in Master’s/ 
Bachelor’s Degree (As

post)

Publications in journal Conference, book chapter etc. or 
previous work experience in the relevant field) 
Total Marks 
25 Marks 25 Marks 50 Marks

NOT automatically entitle an applicant to be called for an interview . The decision of the 
Institute in all matters relating to eligibility, accep tance, or rejection of the application and 
mode of selection will be final and binding on the candidates. No inquiry or correspondence 
will be entertained from individual or agency. 
11. Based on the above stated screening criteria, top ten (10) short -listed ca ndidates against each 
respective advertised project/position shall be called for interview(s). 
12. A duly constituted Selection Committee will conduct the recruitment process. 
13. Selected candidates must produce a ll original documents/certificates at the time of joining for 
necessary verification. 
14. At the time of the verification of original documents or even after selection, if it is found that the 
applicant has attempted to wilfully conceal, misrepresent or canvass the facts, such applicant will 
not be considered  for selection  or terminated , and due action will be taken. Relaxation in the 
upper age limit shall be applicable in accordance with the Government of India, Ministry of 
Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions (Department of Personnel & Training) OM No. 
15012/2/2010- Estt. (D)dated 27.03.2012, as amended from time to time.  
As of now, the categories of upper-age relaxations are as follows: 
a. Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes up to 5 years. 
b. Other Backward Class (OBC) up to 3 years. 
 
:: 4 :: 
 
15. The positions advertised are purely temporary basis for the project period as specif ied in the 
advertisement. These will stand abolished after the completion of the project. 
16. Candidates not found suitable for a particular post as advertised may be considered for a position 
at a lower grade as per recommendations of the Interview Committee. In this regard, 
recommendations/ approval of the Interview Committee shall be considered as final , with due 
approval of the competent authority. 
17. The Institute's rules and regulations govern t he project's tenure  and code of conducts of the

RECRUITMENT NOTIFICATION FOR SCIENTIST-C POSITIONS

Applications are invited from eligible Indian citizens for filling up 03 (three) positions of 'Scientist-C' on
a Direct Recruitment (D.R.) basis at the Wildlife Institute of India (WII), Dehradun.

*One (07) post in OBC category of Scientist-C is carried forward from the 2024 recruitment to fill up the

backlog vacancy.


 
. Terms and Conditions

Posting & Transfer: The headquarters for the post is WII, Dehradun. However, selected
candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India as per functional requirements.

Age Limit: Minimum 24 years and maximum 35 years as on the last date for receipt of
applications.

Age Relaxation: Upper age limit is relaxable for OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwBD candidates in
accordance with instructions/orders issued by the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT),
Government of India, from time to time.

Category Certificates: Candidates belonging to OBC-NCL, EWS, SC, ST, or PwBD categories,
may ensure that they fulfill the prescribed norms issued by the Government of India, Ministry of
Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions (Department of Personnel & Training) from time to
time and submit valid requisite certificate in the prescribed format (Annexure — 4 and Annexure —
2).

Calculation of Experience: Professional experience in the requisite discipline/area will be
counted only after acquiring the mandatory minimum educational qualification and must be
supported by credible documentary evidence.

Nature of Duties: The job involves teaching, training, and extensive field research requiring travel
to remote forest interiors, high-altitude areas, and islands.

Probation Period: Selected candidates will be placed on probation for a period of two years.
Satisfactory completion of probation is mandatory for confirmation.

Allowances: Candidates holding a degree in Veterinary Science are not entitled to Non-Practicing
Allowance (NPA).

. Application Fee

Fee Amount: 24,000/- (Rupees One Thousand only).

Mode of Payment: Non-refundable application fee must be deposited via Demand Draft (DD)
drawn in favour of 'The Director, Wildlife Institute of India’, payable at Dehradun.

Fee Exemption: SC, ST, PwBD, and Female candidates across all categories are exempted from
payment of fee. General, OBC, and EWS male candidates are required to pay the full fee.

. Selection Process

Screening & Shortlisting: Applications will be evaluated by a Screening Committee. Fulfilling
minimum eligibility criteria does not automatically entitle an applicant to be called for the
test/interview. Shortlisting for interviews will maintain a 4:5 ratio (05 candidates per vacancy). The
institute may anytime increase or decrease the ratio for shortlisting the candidate for appearing in
interview.

Written Examination: Comprises subject-specific Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4/3rd
negative marking for incorrect answers. Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for UR/EWS/OBC and
40% for SC/ST/PwBD.

 
Interview: The Institute's Committee for Recruitment & Selection (ICRS) will assess the
candidates based on the academic record, experience in the relevant field, special achievements /
awards, teaching experience, publications, and extension / education / institution building.
Weightage Distribution: 70% weightage for the Written Test and 30% weightage for the
Personal Interview (including presentation).

Final Selection: Final merit list will be prepared based on aggregated performance in the Written
Examination and Interview.

Schedule Intimation: The date(s) for the written test and interview will be hosted on our website
and intimated to the short-listed candidates.

. How to Apply

Application Submission: The candidates should submit the application in the prescribed format
(Annexure - 3) by Registered /Speed Post to The Registrar, Wildlife Institute of India,
Chandrabani, Dehradun 24800, Uttarakhand super-scribing ‘Application for the post of Scientist-
C' on the envelope. The last date for receipt of application along with self-attested copies of
supporting documents (list attached) is 02-42-2026 up to 700hrs. However, applications from
Indian citizens residing abroad and those from Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep,
State/Union Territories in the Northeastern region, Ladakh, Pangi sub Division of Chamba, Lahaul
& Spiti districts of Himachal Pradesh will be accepted till O9-2-2026 up to 7700hrs.

In-Service Candidates: The candidates who are already in regular Government service, whether
in permanent or temporary capacity other than casual/ adhoc/ contract basis etc. are required to
submit a declaration that they have informed in writing to their Head of Office/Department that they
have applied for the position (Annexure - 4). Incomplete applications will be rejected.

. General Instructions

Canvassing: Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.

Shortlisting Criteria: Mere fulfillment of the minimum advertised qualifications and desired
professional experience requirement DOES NOT automatically entitle an applicant to be called for
the written test/interview.

Right of Rejection: The Director, Wildlife Institute of India, Dehradun reserves the right to reject
any or all applications without assigning any reason(s).

Jurisdiction: Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this
advertisement and/ or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Hon'ble High
Court of Uttarakhand at Nainital.

Registrar
Wildlife Institute of India
Dehradun

Dated: 02nd November, 2026 
 
 
CORRIGENDUM 02/ 2026 (Ref. Advt 01/2026) 
 
 
With reference to Advertisement No. 01/2026, the qualification required for the notified post, 
i.e Xth Class with National Trade Certificate (NTC) & National Apprenticeship Certificate 
(NAC) shall include Xth Class with National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) acquired as ITI 
Training of two years followed by Apprenticeship Training of one year (e.g. Electrician trade) 
or directly completed the Apprenticeship Training of three years duration as fresher.  
 
For the above purpose, the candidates acquiring  National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC)  
as fresher, should fill the same marks in the ITI/  National Trade Certificate (NTC)  field and 
such candidates shall be considered equivalent to the qualification as notified in the 
Advertisement.  
  
 
 
 
संशोधन पत्र 02/2026 (संदर्भ: विज्ञापन 01/2026) 
 
विज्ञापन संख्या 01/2026 क े  संबंध में, अधिसूधित पद के धिए आवश्यक योग्यता (यानी 10वीीं कक्षा के साथ 
नेशनि ट्रेड सधट्िधिक े ट् (NTC) और नेशनि अप्रेंधट्सधशप सधट्िधिक े ट् (NAC)) में धनम्नधिखित भी शाधमि होींगे: 
10वीीं कक्षा के साथ नेशनि अप्रेंधट्सधशप सधट्िधिक े ट् (NAC) - धिसे या तो दो साि की ITI ट्रेधनींग और उसक े 
बाद एक साि की अप्रेंधट्सधशप ट्रेधनींग (उदाहरण के धिए, इिेक्ट्रीधशयन ट्रेड) के माध्यम से प्राप्त धकया गया हो, 
या धिर सीिे फ्र े शर के तौर पर तीन साि की अप्रेंधट्सधशप ट्रेधनींग पूरी करके प्राप्त धकया गया हो। 
 
इस उद्देश्य के धिए, िो उम्मीदवार फ्र े शर के तौर पर नेशनि अप्रेंधट्सधशप सधट्िधिक े ट् (NAC) प्राप्त करते हैं, 
उन्हें ITI/नेशनि ट्रेड सधट्िधिक े ट् (NTC) वािे कॉिम में वही अींक भरने होींगे | ऐसे उम्मीदवारोीं को धवज्ञापन में 
बताई गई योग्यता के समकक्ष माना िाएगा। 
 
 
Ref: Advt. 01/2026 
BHARAT HEAVY ELECTRICALS LIMITED

Dated: 02nd November, 2026 
 
 
CORRIGENDUM 02/ 2026 (Ref. Advt 01/2026) 
 
 
With reference to Advertisement No. 01/2026, the qualification required for the notified post, 
i.e Xth Class with National Trade Certificate (NTC) & National Apprenticeship Certificate 
(NAC) shall include Xth Class with National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) acquired as ITI 
Training of two years followed by Apprenticeship Training of one year (e.g. Electrician trade) 
or directly completed the Apprenticeship Training of three years duration as fresher.  
 
For the above purpose, the candidates acquiring  National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC)  
as fresher, should fill the same marks in the ITI/  National Trade Certificate (NTC)  field and 
such candidates shall be considered equivalent to the qualification as notified in the 
Advertisement.  
  
 
 
 
संशोधन पत्र 02/2026 (संदर्भ: विज्ञापन 01/2026) 
 
विज्ञापन संख्या 01/2026 क े  संबंध में, अधिसूधित पद के धिए आवश्यक योग्यता (यानी 10वीीं कक्षा के साथ 
नेशनि ट्रेड सधट्िधिक े ट् (NTC) और नेशनि अप्रेंधट्सधशप सधट्िधिक े ट् (NAC)) में धनम्नधिखित भी शाधमि होींगे: 
10वीीं कक्षा के साथ नेशनि अप्रेंधट्सधशप सधट्िधिक े ट् (NAC) - धिसे या तो दो साि की ITI ट्रेधनींग और उसक े 
बाद एक साि की अप्रेंधट्सधशप ट्रेधनींग (उदाहरण के धिए, इिेक्ट्रीधशयन ट्रेड) के माध्यम से प्राप्त धकया गया हो, 
या धिर सीिे फ्र े शर के तौर पर तीन साि की अप्रेंधट्सधशप ट्रेधनींग पूरी करके प्राप्त धकया गया हो। 
 
इस उद्देश्य के धिए, िो उम्मीदवार फ्र े शर के तौर पर नेशनि अप्रेंधट्सधशप सधट्िधिक े ट् (NAC) प्राप्त करते हैं, 
उन्हें ITI/नेशनि ट्रेड सधट्िधिक े ट् (NTC) वािे कॉिम में वही अींक भरने होींगे | ऐसे उम्मीदवारोीं को धवज्ञापन में 
बताई गई योग्यता के समकक्ष माना िाएगा। 
 
 
Ref: Advt. 01/2026 
BHARAT HEAVY ELECTRICALS LIMITED

Dated: 02nd November, 2026 
 
 
CORRIGENDUM 02/ 2026 (Ref. Advt 01/2026) 
 
 
With reference to Advertisement No. 01/2026, the qualification required for the notified post, 
i.e Xth Class with National Trade Certificate (NTC) & National Apprenticeship Certificate 
(NAC) shall include Xth Class with National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) acquired as ITI 
Training of two years followed by Apprenticeship Training of one year (e.g. Electrician trade) 
or directly completed the Apprenticeship Training of three years duration as fresher.  
 
For the above purpose, the candidates acquiring  National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC)  
as fresher, should fill the same marks in the ITI/  National Trade Certificate (NTC)  field and 
such candidates shall be considered equivalent to the qualification as notified in the 
Advertisement.  
  
 
 
 
संशोधन पत्र 02/2026 (संदर्भ: विज्ञापन 01/2026) 
 
विज्ञापन संख्या 01/2026 क े  संबंध में, अधिसूधित पद के धिए आवश्यक योग्यता (यानी 10वीीं कक्षा के साथ 
नेशनि ट्रेड सधट्िधिक े ट् (NTC) और नेशनि अप्रेंधट्सधशप सधट्िधिक े ट् (NAC)) में धनम्नधिखित भी शाधमि होींगे: 
10वीीं कक्षा के साथ नेशनि अप्रेंधट्सधशप सधट्िधिक े ट् (NAC) - धिसे या तो दो साि की ITI ट्रेधनींग और उसक े 
बाद एक साि की अप्रेंधट्सधशप ट्रेधनींग (उदाहरण के धिए, इिेक्ट्रीधशयन ट्रेड) के माध्यम से प्राप्त धकया गया हो, 
या धिर सीिे फ्र े शर के तौर पर तीन साि की अप्रेंधट्सधशप ट्रेधनींग पूरी करके प्राप्त धकया गया हो। 
 
इस उद्देश्य के धिए, िो उम्मीदवार फ्र े शर के तौर पर नेशनि अप्रेंधट्सधशप सधट्िधिक े ट् (NAC) प्राप्त करते हैं, 
उन्हें ITI/नेशनि ट्रेड सधट्िधिक े ट् (NTC) वािे कॉिम में वही अींक भरने होींगे | ऐसे उम्मीदवारोीं को धवज्ञापन में 
बताई गई योग्यता के समकक्ष माना िाएगा। 
 
 
Ref: Advt. 01/2026 
BHARAT HEAVY ELECTRICALS LIMITED

6. Mode of Selection: 
 
 
1)      The selection methodology will comprise Online Test and a Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT)  
followed by verification of certificates of the shortlisted candidates . The SPPT will be of qualifying 
nature. 
 
2)      The online test shall be for 120 marks  of two parts viz., General Aptitude (Verbal Ability, G.K, 
Reasoning / Logical Deductions & Numerical Ability) comprising of 50 Questions and concerned 
discipline knowledge with 70 Questions. ¼ mark per wrong answer per question shall be 
deducted. The questions shall be objective type Multiple Choice Q uestions with total time duration of 
2 hours.  
 
3)      The exam is scheduled to be held tentatively 10.03.2024 at Chennai only.   
 
4)      Admit cards for Online Test will be issued to all prima -facie eligible candidates on the basis of the 
details furnished in Online -Application form and submission of application fees (applicable for UR, 
EWS & OBC (NCL) Category candidates). Scrutiny of documents submitted by the candidates will be 
carried out post Online Test. Only those candidates will be considered/ called for next stage  i.e. 
Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT) who are (a) shortlisted on the basis of online test and (b) meet 
the notified eligibility criteria upon verification of documents sent / submitted by the candidates and 
other parameters. 
 
5)      Short listed candi dates, in the ratio of 1:2 (two candidates for one post, with due cognizance to 
number of reserved posts) subject to securing minimum qualifying marks in the online test, will be 
required to undergo a Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). 
 
6)      In case o f tie of marks in the written test for the last position on the Shortlist for SPPT, all such 
candidates shall be called for the SPPT, even if the total number exceeds the prescribed ratio.  
 
7)      Category-wise Merit list shall be drawn on the basis of marks  obtained in the Online Test from & out 
of the said short-list; only for such candidates who qualify in the SPPT. 
 
8)      In case of tie of marks for the last position on the Merit List, the candidate with prior date of birth 
(senior by age) shall find a place in the Merit list. 
 
9)      The candidates will be finally selected subject to their being found medically fit.  
 
10) Candidates are advised to visit our website from time to time for updated details related to the 
conduct of the online test.  
 
11) PwBD (availing of relaxation in qualification or written test qualifying marks) and Ex -Servicemen 
candidates, if found suitable, will be considered against reserved vacancy irrespective of their position 
in Merit list (in order of merit within the category) on horizontal reservation policy 
 
12) However, a PwBD candidate availing of only age relaxation (no relaxation in eligibility qualification 
marks / in Written test qualifying Marks) shall be considered against an unreserved post in order of 
merit in the select list, before being considered against a reserved post.

9. How to Apply: 
  
Instructions to the candidates "How to Apply" through online 
 
The candidates who are applying for this recruitment can use their current & active E -Mail ID & Mobile 
Number. Those who do not have an e -mail ID and Mobile No. should create an e -mail ID and to have a 
Mobile Number.

10.       General Rules / Instructions:  
 
(i)      A candidate is allowed to apply for only one post . While applying for any post, the applicant  should 
ensure that he / she fulfills  the eligibility criteria and other norms mentioned, as on the specified dates 
and that the particulars furnished are correct in all respects.  
 
(ii)      Candidates are hereby informed that any Corrigendum/ Addendum etc. wi th regard to this 
advertisement will be made available on www.cpcl.co.in only. Candidates are advised to refer to the 
above website periodically for updates. All future correspondence with respect to the advertised posts 
will be made only through www.cpcl.co.in. 
 
(iii)      Candidates need not submit /send at any address, application printouts or any certificates or copies 
thereof at the time of online application. Their candidature will be considered on the strength of the 
information declared in the application. If at any stage, it is found that any information furnished in the 
online application is false/ incorrect or if according to CPCL, the candidate does not satisfy the 
eligibility criteria, his/ her candidature/ appointment is liable to be cancelled/ terminated.  
 
(iv)      All the educational qualifications mentioned should be from a University  / Institution/ Board recognized 
by Govt. of India  / approved by Govt. Regulatory Bodies.  If grades are awarded instead of marks, 
candidates should clearly indicate its numerical equivalent (i.e. convert to percentage of marks).  
 
(v)      Candidates are advised in their own interest to apply online much before the closing date and not to 
wait till the last date for depositing the fee to a void the possibility of disconnection/ inability  / failure to 
log on to the website on account of heavy load on internet or website jam.  
 
(vi)      CPCL shall not entertain requests from the candidates seeking advice about their eligibility to apply.  
 
(vii) Candidates will have to visit the same website for downloading Admit cards . Intimation for 
downloading admit card will also be sent through email/SMS. Once the candidate clicks the relevant 
link, he/she can access the window for admit card  download. The candidate  is required to use (i) 
Application Number/Roll Number, (ii) Password  / Date of Birth for downloading the call letter. 
Candidate needs to affix recent recognizable photograph on the admit card  preferably the same as 
provided during registration and appear at the examination centre with (i) Admit Card  (ii) Photo 
Identity Proof as specified in the Admit Card  and photocopy of the same Photo Identity Proof as 
brought in original. Admit cards will not be sent by post. 
 
(viii) The candidates will have to appear for the test and for the document verification at their own cost.   
 
(ix)      SC / ST candidates called for Online Test / SPPT / Document Verification Process will be reimbursed 
single Second Class Railway / Bus fare from the nearest railway station of the mailing add ress to the 
place of test / document verification and back by the shortest route on production of ticket, provided 
the distance is not less than 30 kms. Reimbursement will be made subject to submission of TA claim 
along with original rail ticket / receipt or photocopy thereof or original bus tickets(s) and copy of 
Community Certificate. Reimbursement of travel claim will not be allowed, if Community Certificate is 
not produced and if the SC / ST candidate is found ineligible as per Press Advertisement crite rion.  
 
(x)     CANDIDATES REPORTING LATE i.e. after the reporting time specified on the Admit Card  for 
Examination will not be permitted to take the examination. The reporting time mentioned on the admit 
card is prior to the Start Time of the test. Though the  duration of the examination is 2 hours, 
candidates may be required  to be at the venue for about 1 hour  including the time required for

giving of instructions, etc.
